prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ENV02 MIDGROUND, a separately painted transparent environment layer for mobile storybook puzzle game Almost God. Full LANDSCAPE 1536 by 1024 canvas.
Primary request: Two small architectural groups framing a sunny garden kitchen courtyard. At upper left: warm terracotta-brick open kitchen arcade with an arched cold oven opening, a copper chimney, three small hanging copper pans high on its rear wall, climbing sage herbs. At upper right: a charming turquoise glass greenhouse corner on an apricot stone base, a wooden spice cupboard against the far wall and small lavender flowers attached to the architecture. Distinct kitchen-garden character, handmade Mediterranean shapes.
Style: polished warm gouache on paper, broad textured brush strokes, creamy highlights, lavender shadows, copper orange, muted sage and turquoise. Storybook game art, no photorealism.
Composition: Only the upper outer corners carry architecture. Leave central60percent of the canvas entirely transparent and the lower60percent entirely transparent. Architecture may extend at most22percent inward from each side and40percent down from top. No connecting ground or background. Keep full transparent canvas margins.
Constraints: Actual transparent alpha outside architecture. No sky, no hillside background, no ground plane, no courtyard floor, no water pool, no water bowl, no near gameplay brazier, NO FLAME, NO FIRE, NO SMOKE, NO STEAM. The oven is visibly unlit. No food, no characters, no tools floating in the center, no lettering, no UI, no watermark. A compositing layer, not a complete scene.
